scenes.say: Las Vegas has hosted Formula One three times, and every time something went off script.
Twenty twenty-three. In first practice a loose cover wrecks Sainz's Ferrari, and the next session starts two and a half hours late.
In the race Verstappen gets five seconds for pushing Leclerc wide at the start, and wins anyway.
Twenty twenty-four. Russell wins from pole, Hamilton comes through from tenth to second.
And fifth place was enough for Verstappen to clinch his fourth title right there in Vegas.
Twenty twenty-five. Norris second, Piastri fourth, then both McLarens are thrown out for plank wear.
Follow the fourth Vegas race on the LapRadar live map.

title: Three Las Vegas GPs, three dramas: a manhole, a title and a double DSQ
